summary: Four-phase plan written to make models.semantic.MAX_N (=20) the single authoritative N ceiling. Phase 1 adds a settings-layer N range check via the existing _validate_setting_range helper; Phase 2 rewrites 8 stale N<=64 declaration sites to be MAX_N-relative; Phase 3 corrects docs/architecture/BUILDER.md; Phase 4 runs the full suite and a residual-64 sweep. Phases 1 and 2 have disjoint territories and can run in parallel. No lazy-all_states refactor (resolved: exponential is inherent to imposition/logos consumers).
decisions_made: all_states stays eagerly materialized; no laziness refactor in scope
No shipped theory DEFAULT_EXAMPLE_SETTINGS['N'] changes (logos=16 has headroom under MAX_N=20)
Settings check goes in validate_example_settings: no CLI/flag path supplies N, so a post-apply_flag_overrides check is unnecessary
Int-ness must be validated before _validate_setting_range, which would otherwise TypeError on a string N
settings/tests/conftest.py invalid_settings fixture has no consumers; Phase 1 deletes it if that holds repo-wide
